Error while starting A5 renewal
Hi fellow mixed couples,

We are on vacation abroad and trying to fill in piba renewal form. We did it in past. Now we did the usual procedure and went to renewal link https://www.gov.il/he/service/requesting-status-for-foreign-life-partner while signed in to gov.il under my Israeli partner account.

We cant submit documents due to error / this message in attached picture. 

Anyone has experience with this? Can it be because non-israeli IP address? We have tried this with mobile phone and desktop. Same result.
